results.name: Real display shader embeds bundled ACES and sRGB chunks exactly once without automatic double encoding
CPU reference retains bundled matrix order, ACES exposure scale and exact OETF coefficients

detail.scope: Independent CPU calculation of bundled GLSL coefficients; no GPU precision/readback claim.

results.name: HDR capability uses one linear HalfFloat scene target followed by one explicit RGBA8 display target
Feed draws disable automatic mapping/XR/shadow refresh while original renderer and target state are restored
Caller receives display-encoded bytes in the same supplied buffer, with no flip or canvas/context operation
New theme exposures are read on every render without replacing targets, geometry, material, or renderer
RGBA8 fallback still transforms display color and explicitly reports unrecoverable HDR clipping
Absent extension API conservatively selects the same declared LDR fallback
Scene draw, display draw and readback failures restore all tested state and leave the pass reusable
Invalid dimensions, buffers, exposure and non-ACES main mapping fail before renderer mutations
Reentrant rendering and in-render disposal are rejected without losing the outer pass state
Idempotent disposal releases exactly the four owned resources and no scene, renderer or original target resource
Module ownership and application integration boundary remain restricted to the new visual pass

scope: Actual production shader source embeds bundled THREE r180 chunks. Independent CPU coefficient/golden reference plus declared renderer-contract fixtures verify two-pass ordering, capability fallback, current exposure, state restoration, resource reuse and ownership. Fixture bytes are CPU-generated, not GPU readback.
nativeFollowUp: Completed separately: native night/hangar HDR execution, desktop/phone captures and active-task night-to-hangar switching are recorded in work/validation/lab-scenes/browser-final.json. This CPU/contract report does not execute GPU shaders; RGBA8 fallback remains contract-tested and was not triggered on that GPU.

integration.preserve: Caller keeps the existing bottom-up row flip and putImageData, and owns the main renderer and task state.
integration.mode: hdr-half-float or ldr-rgba8-fallback; capabilities includes dimensions, transform and explicit fallback limitation.
integration.mainMapping: Requires main renderer.toneMapping === THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping; latest toneMappingExposure is sampled every render.

nativeReview.performedBy: Root via native Codex in-app Chromium/CUA; separate from this CPU/contract suite.
limitations: One actual native blue sort run with three robots; not a new full sorting/stacking/72-cylinder physical regression.
The second theme switch back to night was observed after the run completed; only night→hangar was observed during active movement.
GPU HalfFloat feed path executed; RGBA8 fallback is contract-tested, not exercised on this GPU.
Software exposure and camera geometry are not hardware optical calibration.
